dataset: MetroPT2.csv -- TRAIN B, 2022 (different physical vehicle from dataset_train_2022.csv)

source.version: V2 of concept-doi 10.5281/zenodo.6854239 (V1 rec 6854240 = dataset_train.csv only, same md5 for the shared file)

evidence: Oil_temperature series uncorrelated between files on the overlap (10s-aligned 4h window, all lags -400s..+400s: r in [-0.04, +0.07])

Train A's catastrophic 30 May - 2 Jun oil leak (A oil-temp max -> 80.2C, terminal LPS) is INVISIBLE in this file: normal diurnal band (mean 54-61C, max<=69C), LPS fraction 0.000 across the whole window
Different healthy oil-temp bands: A mean 61-64 / max 71-76 vs B mean 54-57 / max 62-65 -- per-vehicle calibration mandatory for absolute thresholds
consistent with arXiv:2207.05466 'The data collection of the two units began on 12 March 2020'
identity_evidence_2026_09_21.consequence: this file is NOT train A's post-repair continuation; W1's 'repair-era vignette for train A in MetroPT2.csv' idea is CLOSED (train A has no post-repair data; its file ends at an export boundary)

cadence: 1 Hz nominal, millisecond timestamps, ~98% of nominal on full days
columns: 21 (15 APU signals + Flowmeter + 4 GPS cols); sensor semantics = metropt2_manifest.json operator rules + official PDF attribute info in metropt3_manifest.json

failure_events.component_note: 2502.07394's table prints no component column; signature (sustained LPS 3.5h, compressor overload, oil-temp ceiling 97.9C, 18h out-of-service) matches train A's severe clients-pipe leak class, but this is an INFERENCE not a documented label -- GT must encode component=undocumented for this event (spec-inferred stratum)
failure_events.disposition: removed from service; repair gap 5 Jun ~00:00-18:00 (largest gap 19.5h); back in normal service 6 Jun
failure_events.empirical_signature: TP2 climbing/unable to hold (mean 0.5->7.4 bar), Motor_current 4.65->5.15A continuous overload, compressor cutout 11:30 (TP2 -0.00, LPS=1.0), restart 12:30 under 5.1A continuous load until ~14:30, normal by 15:00; Oil_temperature ceiling 97.9C (same as train A's 28 Feb air leak)
failure_events.provenance: arXiv:2502.07394 Table 1 'Failures present in MetroPT2 dataset' (INESC-TEC group, maintenance reports); LPS timestamp verified to the second against local data

failure_events.disposition: removed from service at end (14 Jul); normal service resumes by 15 Jul (clean data, normal band from 14 Jul 12:00)
failure_events.empirical_signature: slow degradation mirroring train A's 30 May oil leak: Oil-temp daily max 62->80.2C climb over 3 days, LPS blips only at the end (19:43:52 for 166s; 14 Jul ~06:00 for ~6min), TP2 max unchanged (normal cycling continues)
failure_events.provenance: arXiv:2502.07394 Table 1; LPS timestamp verified to the second; sustained-LPS days in this file are only 4-5 Jun

healthy_control_pool.exclusions: >=48h after the 5 Jun repair; >=72h before each failure start; A-train events irrelevant here (different vehicle)

physical_ceilings.note: both ceilings identical to train A's for the same failure classes -- treat as sensor/physical limits, not transferable absolute values

design_role: SECOND in-service vehicle: +2 documented failures (1 air + 1 oil) with second-exact LPS verification; enables a two-vehicle fleet-level instantiation of the question bank (same APU type, same operator rules, per-vehicle calibration) -- 2022 documented events total 5 across trains A+B
